intro: Heavy cars, a banked oval and a pack that never spreads out. Tuck in behind someone to go faster, then pull out and pass.
inspiredBy: Oval stock car racing goes back to the 1940s. Stock Cars is our own take, with our own cars, track and drivers.
goal: Be first across the line after the last lap. Races are 3, 5 or 10 laps.
howToPlay: Join with your phone, or race the computer drivers on your own.
In the lobby, choose how many computer drivers, how many laps and how quick they are, then press {bolt} to start.
Your phone becomes a steering pad: slide your thumb left and right to steer. Hold {bolt} for gas and {drop} to brake.
Hold the gas through the countdown and go on Go. Every turn is a left turn.
Get right behind another car and its slipstream pulls you along faster (Draft lights up on your screen). Use the extra speed to pull out and pass.
Bumping is part of it. The outside wall isn't: hit it and you lose a lot of speed.
steering: Slide left and right on your phone to steer (or use the arrow keys)
tips: Pull out of the slipstream late, when you're right on their bumper, to slingshot past.
Sliding up toward the wall in a turn? Steer down. If that isn't enough, ease off the gas for a moment.
The bottom of the track is the shortest way round, so everyone wants it.
Hold {r1} to see who's behind you.
